# SNN_Config_Sensitivity

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The degree to which intrusion detection accuracy and latency vary with changes in SNN hyperparameters, such as threshold, refractory period, or synaptic weights. Highlights the need for systematic configuration tuning in iNEST, as suboptimal settings can degrade detection performance in dynamic network environments.
